sqlite.name: notification_receipt_consents
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE notification_receipt_consents (
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

sqlite.name: notification_delivery_controls
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE notification_delivery_controls (
	delivery_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	review_status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (delivery_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_delivery_review CHECK (review_status IN ('unreviewed','provider_accepted','not_accepted','closed_no_resend','followup_recorded')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(delivery_id) REFERENCES notification_deliveries (id)
)

sqlite.name: notification_delivery_attempts
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE notification_delivery_attempts (
	delivery_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	device_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	receipt_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	provider_reference VARCHAR(250), 
	provider_reported_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (delivery_id, attempt_no), 
	FOREIGN KEY(delivery_id) REFERENCES notification_deliveries (id), 
	UNIQUE (receipt_hash)
)

sqlite.name: notification_delivery_receipts
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE notification_delivery_receipts (
	delivery_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	stage VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	basis VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	reported_at DATETIME, 
	recorded_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (delivery_id, attempt_no, stage), 
	FOREIGN KEY(delivery_id, attempt_no) REFERENCES notification_delivery_attempts (delivery_id, attempt_no), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_delivery_receipt_stage CHECK (stage IN ('RECEIVED','OPENED','ACKNOWLEDGED'))
)

sqlite.name: notification_delivery_reviews
sqlite.sql:
CREATE TABLE notification_delivery_reviews (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	delivery_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	expected_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	decision VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(delivery_id) REFERENCES notification_deliveries (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
